newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise in mid-Nov.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise in mid-Nov.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $153.45 million to $5,566 million in the first half of November from $5,412.6 million in the second half of October, according to central bank figures.
According the bank's bi-monthly balance sheet issued on Monday gross reserves rose by $139.82 million in the second half of October to 5,412.6 million.
The figure includes commercial bank's foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves but banking sources told Reuters they stood at $3.8 billion, unchanged from the end of October.
Net reserves were $2,858 million at the end of 1995 compared with $2.732 million at the end of 1994.
